subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Recognises at least 5 new vowel digraphs (ar, er, ir, or, ur)

show.line: Fern, shirt, church. Different letters, same sound in the middle. Er! Her, bird, nurse. All say er!

rounds.prompt: Which picture has the er sound, like fern?
Read this word. It has the er sound.

rounds.praise: Yes! Nurse, with the er sound.

rounds.prompt: Which picture does not have the er sound?
rounds.praise: Yes! Star has the ar sound.

rounds.prompt: Er like fern, or ar like car? Put each picture in its group.

hints: Stretch the middle. Feeern. Shiiirt. Chuuurch. Same sound!
Three spellings, one sound. Listen, do not just look.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word with the er sound.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Car! Car has the er sound.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Car has the ar sound. Bird has er.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. Fern, bird. Er!

parent_line: Can hear and read the er sound in words like fern, shirt and church.
